messages:
release-bot: started canary rollout of sdk v2.3.4 to staging (10%) rollout_id=r-2026-03-17-48
maya: seeing alerts — paging/streaming error-rate spike ~18m ago :rotating_light:
aj: resumed pagination calls returning 400 with "invalid iterator_token" from router
nate: root cause looks like iterator_token serialization changed in v2.3.4 (urlsafe vs standard base64) — older services expecting old format
oncall-amber: i'm on it. creating incident channel and taking ownership
incident-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0317-iter-json — priority=P1 — oncall=amber
sre-lee: halt the rollout. where's the kill-switch?
maya: there is a feature flag ff.iterator_serial_mode — can flip to "legacy" for staging/affected groups
maya: command:
```
$ curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN\" \\ 
  https://ops-api.redwood/prod/feature-flag -d '{\"ff\":\"iterator_serial_mode\",\"value\":\"legacy\",\"scope\":\"staging\"}'
```
aj: applied the flag to staging — failing calls drop immediately
deploy-bot: rollback job started for rollout r-2026-03-17-48
nate: kicking rollback now — reverting canary cohort to v2.3.3
support-lucy: two customers reported user-visible failures: Customer Acme (mobile list pagination) and BetaAnalytics (resumed reads); marking both as impacted
pm-oliver: prepping short AP and statuspage update for impacted customers
maya: compatibility shim branch ready locally; plan to ship v2.3.4-compat if rollback doesn't fully clear all edges
aj: will review hotfix PR as soon as it's up
nate: rollback completed — affected clusters back to v2.3.3; metrics normalizing
aj: error rate returned to baseline ~4m after rollback; paging endpoints healthy
support-lucy: notified customers of rollback and created support tickets with suggested mitigations
oncall-amber: handing to SRE for postmortem and follow-ups. @sre-lee please lead
sre-lee: taking lead on postmortem. immediate action items: 1) accept rollback as mitigation 2) ship lenient iterator parser hotfix 3) add e2e tests for both iterator formats 4) add serialization compatibility check to release gating
pm-oliver: note for postmortem: insufficient compatibility tests for client resume protocol and rollout gating too permissive
incident-bot: INC-2026-0317-iter-json updated -> mitigated
oncall-amber: closing incident channel, follow-up doc to be posted under #postmortems/iterator-2026-03-17
sre-lee: postmortem owners: maya, nate, aj, support-lucy, pm-oliver. ETA: postmortem draft by EOD tomorrow
maya: opening backport PR for hotfix now and requesting reviews from @aj and @nate
aj: acked, will review quickly
nate: plan after hotfix: progressive re-release with stricter canary pauses and serialization checks
support-lucy: customers confirmed notified and tickets acknowledged :white_check_mark:
